name: Dwain Streeter
background: Dwain Streeter of Albany County won the 2026 Republican primary for clerk of district court and lost the November 2026 general election. The Laramie Reporter reported the results as 6,003 votes (48%) to Kayla Marroquin's 6,479 (52%). No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
